label: DISMISSED

issue_findings.holding: SYNTHETIC TEMPLATE - the signed FY 2017-18 balance sheet showing the loan is an acknowledgment of liability on these facts.

authorities_relied.title: Asset Reconstruction Co. v. Bishal Jaiswal

issue_findings.holding: SYNTHETIC TEMPLATE - the acknowledgment on 05.09.2018 was made before the period expired on 31.12.2018; a fresh period ran from it, and the application of 10.01.2020 was within time.

authorities_relied.title: B.K. Educational Services v. Parag Gupta

ratio_decidendi: SYNTHETIC TEMPLATE - a signed balance sheet entry made before limitation expires can extend limitation for a Section 7 application under Section 18 of the Limitation Act.
operative_order_verbatim: SYNTHETIC TEMPLATE - The appeal is dismissed. No costs.
